value.answer: Call 911 now if this seizure is still happening, or go to the ER right away since your child is still floppy and drowsy afterward - this needs to be checked in person now.
value.triage: Call 911 now for any seizure lasting over 5 minutes, repeat seizures, trouble breathing, blue lips, or a child who won't wake or stay alert - get to an ER now given the current drowsiness/floppiness. Once fully back to normal and staying that way, call 811 to talk through next steps and follow-up.
